CustomObject.label: OI Hierarchy Definition
CustomObject.description: A configured hierarchy type (e.g. Corporate, Territory, Dealer) — Hierarchy Accelerator epic (ADR-0022). Structurally separate from the metadata graph's OI_Graph_Node__c/Edge__c: real Salesforce sharing applies (ReadWrite OWD, tightenable via standard sharing rules), not the Apex-boundary model ADR-0006 defines for application-internal objects.
